## Activity

For December 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 238 captures. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the referable results identified during grading.

## Image quality

A total of 17 captures were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1. This measure indicates the proportion of the reported captures for which image quality did not support grading. The ungradable total and rate should continue to be reviewed as part of routine site operations and quality monitoring.

## Grading

Grading identified 47 referable results from the December 2020 activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during the reporting period. Together, the referable total and median lag summarise the grading activity recorded for Harbour Eye Clinic.
